title: YOLO-AD-Framework
description: Comparative research‑driven framework using YOLOv5, YOLOv8 etc. for anomaly detection in video streams.

title: Face Recognition & Attendance
description: Real‑time face recognition system using webcam and OpenCV; logs attendance with timestamps.

title: Anomaly Detection (Fire & Theft)
description: Hackathon project detecting fire & theft anomalies using YOLOv8 and custom tracking in video streams.

title: Train Custom YOLO Model
description: End-to-end custom YOLO model training pipeline using Colab—data prep, labeling, training, inference.

title: AI Virtual Mouse
description: Hand‑gesture controlled virtual mouse using Mediapipe and OpenCV for hands‑free interaction.

title: Brain Tumor Detection (LDW-CNet)
description: Developed 'LDW-CNet', a lightweight CNN that uses Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) for enhanced feature extraction from MRI scans, improving tumor detection accuracy.

title: ExoX: Environmental Monitoring
description: A real-time dashboard to monitor IoT sensor data (like CO levels) using Supabase for real-time streams, auth, an interactive map, and a Gemini-powered AI chatbot.

title: Multi-Modal Forensic Detection of AI-Generated Images
description: Conducted extensive research on detecting AI-generated media. Pivoted from complex multi-modal architectures to a robust, data-centric EfficientNet-B0 model achieving a state-of-the-art 99.5% F1-score.

title: AI-Integrated Smart Mobility and Urban Safety System
description: Architected a Hybrid Edge-Cloud system for real-time traffic management using YOLOv8 and SORT for 30 FPS vehicle detection and violation monitoring, integrated with a React/Supabase dashboard for <200ms latency.

title: E2AM-Framework: Energy-Aware Multi-Model Workspace
description: Designed an energy-aware workspace enabling 684+ hours (28.5 days) of continuous GPU training across CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and Tiny-ImageNet datasets. Achieved reproducibility with 225 completed model configurations and 11,250 trained epochs, supporting training, ablation, and deployment of diverse vision models.

title: E2AM-Library: Structured Workflow for Reproducible Research
description: Official library of the E2AM framework, encapsulating its workflow, methodology, and practices. Provides a structured foundation for experimentation, implementation, and reproducible research across diverse vision models.

title: AutoSource: Autonomous Multi-Agent Procurement & Negotiation Network
description: Open-source autonomous multi-agent procurement and negotiation system designed to empower small organizations with enterprise-level supply-chain capabilities. AutoSource leverages modular agents to monitor inventory, coordinate sourcing, negotiate vendor discounts, and ensure human-in-the-loop approval, delivering reproducible and cost-efficient procurement workflows.
